settings.local_only: Show agents of this machine only
settings.proxy_hint: Behind a corporate proxy enter it here, otherwise the connection fails. Format: http://HOST:PORT.
settings.pool_hint: One name and a comma separated list of agent names per pool. The active pool is used for new agents.
settings.db_hint: The message bus is a SQLite database in WAL mode. Writing goes exclusively through the sanctuary command so that there is exactly one writer.
about.description:
Control center for several Claude Code
sessions running side by side
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: This application observes Claude Code sessions on your machines, hands tasks to them and can end sessions. It therefore performs actions that may change data.
disclaimer.duty_authorisation: You are authorised to control the machines and sessions involved.
disclaimer.duty_actions: You are responsible for what the commissioned agents do - the program does not review tasks for content.
disclaimer.duty_data: You will not pass data over the message bus that has no business being on the target machine.
tip.version: Claude Code version of this session. If it differs between machines, an update is due there.

mem.col.name: Note
mem.tip.in: How many other notes point here
mem.tip.recalls: How often this note was demonstrably loaded into a session
mem.headline: How Claude Code remembers
mem.lead: Two parts with very different costs. The index sits in context at EVERY session start, the notes only when recalled.
mem.limit.title: How full the index is
mem.limit.warn: Only {frei} lines left. Past the limit it is silently truncated.
mem.limit.hint: Both limits are hard-wired. Anything beyond them disappears without notice - and it is the most recent entries that go.
mem.cost.title: What it costs
mem.cost.sum_note: The same index across the {sitzungen} sessions measured
mem.cost.per_line: One index line costs about {tokens} tokens per session.
mem.cost.lesson: That is why deleting a note saves almost nothing. Only what leaves the index counts.
mem.estimate: Token figures are estimates (characters divided by {faktor}).
mem.types.title: Kinds of note
mem.health.title: Checks
mem.health.ok: Nothing to report. Index and links are consistent.
mem.biggest.title: The largest notes
mem.recall.title: What actually gets recalled
mem.recall.none: Not measured yet. {shortcut} reads the transcripts.
mem.recall.summary: {zugeordnet} recalls across {notizen} notes, from {dateien} transcripts ({mb} MB). {nie} of {gesamt} notes were never recalled.
mem.recall.unassigned: {anzahl} recalls could not be matched to a note - excerpts without header data.
mem.recall.floor: This is a lower bound: only what the surviving transcripts contain is counted.
mem.diet.title: Where the room is
mem.diet.done: {anzahl} notes describe finished work. Merged into one collective note, that saves about {tokens} tokens every session.
mem.diet.hint: Merge rather than delete - the content stays, the index gets shorter.
mem.detail.lines: {zeilen} lines, {zeichen} characters, about {tokens} tokens on recall
mem.detail.recalls_value: loaded {anzahl}x, last when the note was {tage} days old
mem.detail.done: Reports finished work - a candidate for merging.
bus.search: Search - agent, topic or message text
bus.expiry.after: An unclaimed task expires after {n} hours.
bus.expiry.off_hint: Without a deadline every abandoned task stays in the bus forever.
bus.binding.name: addressed to the name {name}, not to a session
bus.binding.role_open: {n} open message(s) address a name instead of a session.
bus.binding.role_hint: Only these can be inherited by a later holder of the same name. Expiry limits that.
bus.binding.all_bound: Every open message is bound to a session.
stats.parallel: How many sessions ran at the same time
stats.spend: Tokens per day - cache reads excluded
stats.duration: Spend by session duration - median in million tokens
stats.folders: Processed per folder - million tokens, cache reads excluded
stats.warn.inheritable: open messages a later holder of the name could inherit
stats.warn.orphaned: open tasks whose recipient session is gone
stats.warn.recycled: names that served more than one session in the period
stats.warn.long: sessions with a long active span
stats.warn.long_hint: Long means: more than {h} hours between first and last request.
stats.warn.names_known: Names known for {n} of {gesamt} sessions - the rate is a lower bound.
stats.warn.waiting: How long the open tasks have been waiting
stats.foot.caveat: Measured is active duration, first to last request - not how long a window stayed open. Subagents have been counted since 24.08.2026: they live under <session>/subagents/ and were missed before.
search.hint_empty: Just type - the index covers what was said, not tool output.
log.index_done: Search index: {dateien} transcripts, {neu} new, {aktualisiert} refreshed, {entfernt} removed ({s} s)
